root_idea.summary: The root centers on leaving something and holding back from it, especially by withholding aid or assistance.
root_idea.development: This principle extends to abandonment, being left without support, and reciprocal desertion. Related Classical usages describe an animal remaining behind and a limb failing to support its bearer.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form I verb group, normalized to the Classical perfect citation form.
Distinct Quran-attested adjective with an established habitual-agent meaning.

senses.definition: To withhold aid from, hold back from, abandon, or forsake someone.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the verb describes the withholding of help from those addressed.

senses.definition: To fail to preserve or protect someone, so that he falls into an evil action.
senses.usage_conditions: This preservation or protection nuance is explicitly associated with the Quranic Form I usage alongside the sense of failing to aid.

senses.definition: Left without an aider or assister; forsaken and unsupported.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of one who has been deprived of support.

senses.definition: One who habitually withholds aid or repeatedly abandons those who rely on him.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the adjective is applied to Satan, who forsakes the unbeliever and disavows him in a time of trial or affliction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a gazelle or other wild animal, to hold back from the herd and remain behind, including remaining with its young.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in descriptions of a wild animal that does not keep pace with its companions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incite or induce someone to withhold aid, and to hinder or prevent him from assisting another; also to make him cowardly or weak-hearted and refrain from fighting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II usage involving dissuasion from aiding or fighting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a young wild animal, to find its mother holding back from the herd, leaving it, or remaining behind with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction describing the young animal's perception of the mother's withdrawal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mutually withhold aid or abandon one another in trouble; also, to flee from battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI usage describing collective withdrawal or desertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a person's legs, to become weak and fail to support him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of the legs when weakened by an ailment or other adverse condition.
A Classical usage describing a position of lagging behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be without aid or assistance; also, to flee.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VII usage expressing lack of support or withdrawal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who habitually withholds or neglects aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A characterization of persistent failure to assist others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mare that remains in place during the pain of parturition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical description of a mare during labor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose leg fails to support him because of weakness, an ailment, or intoxication.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic bodily description centered on the leg's failure to aid its bearer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who withholds aid or leaves, forsakes, or deserts another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general active-participial description of failure to assist or abandonment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female gazelle or wild cow that holds back from her companions, remains behind or alone with her young, or has deserted her young.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in specialized animal descriptions; the reported variants concern remaining with or leaving the young.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Routed, defeated, or put to flight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical resultative usage describing one overcome in conflict.
